title: Supervised Anomaly Detection for Complex Industrial Images (SegAD)
mechanism: Per-region statistics of anomaly maps inside segmentation-map regions, plus an optional supervised score, feed a boosted random forest that makes the final decision.
adaptation: Per-cell features = house crack/inactive probabilities and AD scores inside structural regions (busbar, ribbon, cell body); BRF predicts cell has crack >= 20 px and inactive-fraction band, for post-evaluation / severity.
min_experiment: Arm BRF on house + AD region stats vs baseline house-ensemble max crack prob per cell; metric cell-level crack recall at 95% precision on CV and E1; kill if gain < +0.03. Under 2 GPU-h.
evidence: R: +2.1% AUROC on VAD (5,000 images, 2,000 real defects), +0.4% on VisA.
